summary: Phase C polish — Contacts Unification (Contact CRM Panel). Backend endpoints (POST activities, GET crm-summary, PATCH stage/lead_source) validated end-to-end against the live preview URL and via existing pytest. Frontend ContactCrmPanel renders on /contacts/:id above the transaction report drawer with all 5 stage pills, KPIs, deal list, unified activity feed, activity composer, deal drawer, and New Deal modal all wired correctly.

design_issues.screen: DealFormModal opened from ContactCrmPanel New Deal button
issues: Requirement says the contact should be 'locked in' when opening the modal from the CRM panel — currently the contact dropdown is pre-selected with Acme Corp but remains editable. Pre-fill works (submitted deal is linked to the current contact), but a user could accidentally change the contact. Consider disabling/read-only-ing the contact selector when `defaultContactId` is provided.

action_items: (Optional UX) Lock/disable the Contact selector inside DealFormModal when `defaultContactId` prop is present, so the pre-filled contact cannot be changed accidentally.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactCrmPanel.jsx: activityBody 'Enter' key handler calls logActivity() even when body is empty — logActivity() short-circuits (returns without a toast), but pressing Enter on an empty input gives no user feedback. Not blocking; could add a subtle validation hint.

ContactCrmPanel.jsx: `defaultValue` on the lead_source input means the input is uncontrolled; if `load()` refreshes the summary while the user is mid-edit, the input value can go stale silently. Consider `key={contact.lead_source}` on the input or converting to controlled state.

routes/contacts.py update_contact: accepts a raw dict payload with no validation — any client can PATCH arbitrary fields into a contact doc (including things like `company_id`, `id`, or `stage='foo'`). Recommend a whitelist (e.g., accept only {name,email,phone,address,type,stage,lead_source,logo_url,notes,...}) and validate `stage` against `_CRM_STAGES` if present.

routes/contacts.py contact_crm_summary: deals list is fetched with `.to_list(500)` — no cap warning; fine for now but note that stats aggregation is O(N) in Python. If a contact ever has >500 deals it silently truncates.

If more work happens here, note (1) the DealFormModal contact selector is not truly 'locked' when opened via New Deal button — only pre-filled; (2) contact PATCH has no whitelist so stage validation lives only client-side.
